info.name: Clinic JPA and JPQL Requirements
info.description: Individual Postman requests for requirements A1-A4, B1-B4, C1-C4, and the two bonus requirements. The URLs and request bodies use the real seeded data currently in the clinic database: patient Aline Uwase (23), doctor Alice Mugisha (13), Room 101 (14), Cardiology (13), and October 2026 appointments (IDs 21-30). Base URL: http://localhost:1014. Run A4 before C4; C4 changes appointment statuses. Run the bonus cleanup last; it deletes records.
